cases.statement: One accession number (A0006) in PMID 22134107; 1 family (1 allele), references [3, 22, 44]. A0006 is also listed under c.1602C>A (p.Cys534X).

people.label: A0006
people.zygosity_or_genotype: heterozygous for this variant, implied compound heterozygous (A0006 also listed under c.1602C>A)
people.other_allele: c.1602C>A (p.Cys534X), listed under the same accession number
people.key_phenotypes: LAD-I type of the table row: LAD-I^o/- (mutant CD18 supports differentially the expression of the different CD11/CD18 integrins, per the table notes); no clinical features reported per person

quotes.quote: Identification of four CD18 mutations in leukocyte adhesion deficient (LAD) patients with differential abilities to associate with the CD11a, CD11b and CD11c antigens
o/-indicates that the mutant CD18 molecule supports differentially the expression of the different CD11/CD18 integrins.

In this nomenclature the superscript symbol indicates whether the protein is present at < 5% of normal expression (^o), diminished in expression (^−), i.e. between 5% and 20% of normal expression, or normally present but nonfunctional (^+)

phenotype_specificity.statement: PMID 22134107 gives no person-level clinical features or exclusion of other causes; it describes the disease only in general terms.

quotes.quote: Characteristic features are delayed separation of the umbilical cord and strong leukocytosis, especially neutrophilia, during periods of infection.
Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by decreased expression or functioning of CD18, the β_2 subunit of the leukocyte β_2 integrins [1].

in_trans.statement: A0006 is listed under c.1021G>C (1 allele) and c.1602C>A (p.Cys534X). Phase not shown in this paper.

functional.statement: Table I gives LAD-I^o/- (mutant CD18 supports differentially the expression of the different CD11/CD18 integrins, per the table notes). Per the legend, this class is based on flow cytometry of the patients' leukocytes and sometimes on COS-cell co-transfection; which material was used for this variant is not stated, and no numeric results or controls are given.

quotes.quote: o/-indicates that the mutant CD18 molecule supports differentially the expression of the different CD11/CD18 integrins.

In this nomenclature the superscript symbol indicates whether the protein is present at < 5% of normal expression (^o), diminished in expression (^−), i.e. between 5% and 20% of normal expression, or normally present but nonfunctional (^+)

This information is based on immune reactivity of the patients’ leukocytes with monoclonal antibodies analyzed by flow cytometry and sometimes on similar analyses of COS cells cotransfected with mutant CD18 molecules and wild-type CD11 molecules.

variant_type_and_mechanism.statement: Batch HGVS: missense, p.(Ala341Pro), agreeing with the paper's p.Ala341Pro. The paper describes the disease as caused by decreased expression or function of CD18 (the β2 integrin subunit).

quotes.quote: Leukocyte adhesion deficiency (LAD) is an autosomal recessive disorder caused by decreased expression or functioning of CD18, the β_2 subunit of the leukocyte β_2 integrins [1].
Usually, this leads to the absence or decreased expression of the β_2 integrins on the leukocyte surface, but sometimes a normal expression of nonfunctional β_2 integrins is found.

authors_classification.statement: The variant is listed in Table I, which the authors title as mutations in the LAD-I gene ITGB2; no per-variant classification or ACMG criteria are stated.

quotes.quote: TABLE I: Mutations in the LAD-I gene ITGB2

concerns: PMID 22134107 is a mutation-update table (Table I) without case descriptions: people are identified only by database accession numbers, and sex, age and clinical features are not given per person.

In Table I the LAD-I type and the families (alleles) count belong to the table row (the variant), not to one accession number; for an accession number listed with a second variant, the expression class reflects the person's genotype, not this allele alone.
A second ITGB2 variant (c.1602C>A, p.Cys534X) is listed under the same accession number.

The "o/-" class means the mutant CD18 supports the different CD11/CD18 integrins differently; cited source [44] (Shaw et al. 2001) is titled as studying CD18 mutations with differential abilities to associate with CD11a, CD11b and CD11c, but it was not available here.
notes_for_panel: Single table row; the functional detail is in cited sources not read here.
